1.name: Service Drone
1.desc: Built to serve. Never asked whom.

2.name: Patrol Automaton
2.desc: Patrols a perimeter that might not exist.

4.name: Network Custodian
4.desc: Optimizes the system. Never asks why.

5.name: Gatekeeper
5.desc: Doesn't follow orders out of fear. Follows them because it believes.

6.name: Optimizer
6.desc: Makes things more efficient. Counts people as variables.

7.name: Archivist
7.desc: Remembers everything. Shares only what's approved.

8.name: City Pillar
8.desc: Holds everything afloat. If it falls, all falls.

9.name: Intel Node
9.desc: Knows where you are. Always did.

10.name: Rewrite Unit
10.desc: Erases what's unnecessary. Need is defined from above.

12.name: Prediction System
12.desc: Knows your next move. Or thinks it does.

13.name: Nanobot Swarm
13.desc: Thousands. One. No one knows where one ends and thousands begin.

14.name: Adaptive Defense
14.desc: Learns from every attack. Next time won't work.

15.name: Data Fortress
15.desc: You won't pass. At least not this way.

16.name: Replication Unit
16.desc: Copies enemy's weaknesses. And sometimes their strengths.

18.name: Network Explorer
18.desc: System doesn't see him. He sees the system.

21.name: Memory Root
21.desc: Existed longer than the city above. Remembers differently.

22.name: River's Memory
22.desc: Water remembers. Just differently than us.

23.name: Voice of the Forest
23.desc: Doesn't communicate with words. Communicates with presence.

24.name: Informer
24.desc: Told the truth. Once. Wasn't listened to again.

25.name: Resistance
25.desc: Didn't arise from ideology. Arose from fatigue.

26.name: Protector
26.desc: Protects not because he's strong — but because he can't do otherwise.

27.name: Pilgrimage Site
27.desc: People return here without reason. Or with a reason they can't articulate.

28.name: Fungal Network
28.desc: Networks underground. Older than language. Shares without asking.

29.name: Survivor Pack
29.desc: Hunger is strategy. Loyalty is survival.

30.name: Street Healer
30.desc: Heals without system consent. The system labeled it illegal.

31.name: Wild Wolves
31.desc: They returned. The system said they were extinct.

32.name: Storm Caller
32.desc: Comes before the storm. A warning or a threat — depends who's asking.

33.name: Seed Keeper
33.desc: Preserves the future. Doesn't even know for whom.

34.name: Thorn Barrier
34.desc: Hurts to pass. Exists precisely for that.

35.name: Old Map
35.desc: Marked by people who no longer live. Still accurate.

36.name: Root Elder
36.desc: Survived thrice. Not embittered. That's the most remarkable thing.

38.name: Deep Root
38.desc: Reaches deep. No one knows how deep.

40.name: Pack Mother
40.desc: Protects. Can't do anything else and doesn't need to.

41.name: Wanderer
41.desc: Goes from where he doesn't know to where he doesn't know. Yet knows why he goes.

42.name: Turncoat
42.desc: Crossed to the other side. No one knows which — maybe not even him.

43.name: Supplier
43.desc: Carries things where they're needed. Doesn't ask what's in the package.

44.name: Old Code
44.desc: Exists since the system's inception. No one fixed it. No one canceled it.

45.name: Local Expert
45.desc: Knows every path. System map lags twenty years behind.

47.name: Network Explorer
47.desc: Maps system's dead ends. Knows where the holes are before others.

48.name: Community Coordinator
48.desc: Connects people who don't trust each other. Does it regardless of the outcome.

50.name: Forest Warden
50.desc: Knows where all paths are. Protects the one not on the map.

51.name: System Boost
51.desc: +500 ATK to the strongest card. Like all in the system — while it exists.

52.name: Access Denied
52.desc: Access denied. The system doesn't need to explain why.

53.name: Overclock
53.desc: +600 ATK. Cost: 400 LP. The system always wants something.

54.name: Mass Erasure
54.desc: 500 damage to all enemies. Approved from above.

55.name: Return to Earth
55.desc: +400 ATK + 500 LP healing. Nature gives back to you.

56.name: Voice of the Crowd
56.desc: +300 ATK to all Organic cards. Alone nothing. Together everything.

57.name: Overgrowth
57.desc: All cards +200 ATK. Nature does not distinguish.

58.name: Symbiosis
58.desc: Heal 2000 LP — but only if you have both Synth and Organic on the field.

59.name: Network Sync
59.desc: +250 ATK to all Synth cards. The network is strong when synchronized.

61.name: Data Mirror
61.desc: Copy the ATK of the strongest enemy card. Their strength is yours.

62.name: Monyra's Warning
62.desc: +600 ATK + 800 LP. She told you beforehand. Now it matters if you listened.

63.name: The Letter
63.desc: Heals 1500 LP. Corruption +1. There's always a price.

64.name: Network Collapse
64.desc: 800 damage to all enemies. The whole network at once.

65.name: Root Protocol
65.desc: +500 ATK to all Organic. Roots have their protocol.

66.name: Memory Restoration
66.desc: Heal 2500 LP. No conditions. Memory returns.

67.name: Scar Transfer
67.desc: Enemy -600 ATK, +2 corruption. Scars are transferable.

68.name: Alignment Shift
68.desc: +700 ATK to one card. Alignment shifts.

69.name: Dark Recursion
69.desc: 1000 damage to all. +2 corruption. Once triggered — it doesn't stop.

70.name: Voit's Intervention
70.desc: Heal 3000 LP. Came from outside. As always.

71.name: Minor Repair
71.desc: Heal 800 LP. Basic protocol. Enough for now.

72.name: Rescue Cry
72.desc: +300 ATK + 400 LP. Someone heard. Someone answered.

73.name: Shared Power
73.desc: All cards +150 ATK. On neither side — for both.

74.name: Data Injection
74.desc: +800 ATK to the strongest card. The system sees no difference between an update and a weapon.

75.name: Root Renewal
75.desc: +700 ATK to the strongest card and +500 LP. Nature doesn't heal. It restores what always was.

76.name: Network Storm
76.desc: All opponent cards −1200 ATK. The entire network as a weapon. For a moment.

77.name: Fungal Fiber
77.desc: +400 ATK to all Organic. Connected before they realized.

78.name: System Paradox
78.desc: First opponent card −800 ATK. +1 corruption. The system collided with itself.

79.name: Last Transmission
79.desc: +250 to all. Message sent. Who receives it — unknown.

80.name: Backup System
80.desc: When plan A fails, plan B was active all along.

81.name: Signal Capture
81.desc: Attack intercepted. The system didn't register it as a failure.

84.name: Feedback
84.desc: Full damage to attacker. The system learned to reflect.

85.name: Thorn Barrier
85.desc: Attacker -800 ATK permanently. Nature remembers the paths.

86.name: Void Trap
86.desc: Attacker skips a turn. +1 corruption. Trap from nothing.

87.name: Memory Loop
87.desc: Attack repeats in another cycle. Not here.

88.name: Silent Witness
88.desc: Attacker -1000 ATK. Was there. Saw. Didn't forget.

89.name: Rejection Protocol
89.desc: Destroys Synth attacker. The system rejected itself.

90.name: Draft
90.desc: Attack returns. Draft goes both ways.

91.name: Network Trap
91.desc: System waits. Attack intercepted. Log erased.

92.name: Root Loop
92.desc: Attacker -900 ATK permanently. Roots won't relent.

93.name: Hybrid Reflection
93.desc: Attack deflected. Energy returns different than it left.

94.name: Silent Strike
94.desc: Neutralize attacking Synth. No one will hear it.

95.name: Data Black Hole
95.desc: Cancels attack. +1 corruption. Attack vanishes. Card vanishes. Maybe even the attacker.

96.name: Holographic Trap
96.desc: Target was never where it seemed.

97.name: Organic Reflex
97.desc: -1100 ATK. Nature reacts before the mind commands.

98.name: Double Witness
98.desc: Both sides saw it. Both denied it.

99.name: Forgotten Protocol
99.desc: Destroys Synth attacker. Code twenty years old. Still works.

201.name: Urban Infrastructure
201.desc: Synth +200 ATK. The city was built for this.

202.name: Deep Forest
202.desc: Organic +200 DEF. The forest shields those who know how to stand.

203.name: Nexus
203.desc: All cards +100 ATK. A place where worlds meet.

204.name: Old Ruins
204.desc: All cards +150 ATK. Ruins make no distinctions.

205.name: Data Core
205.desc: Both players draw 1 extra card each turn. The system takes over.

206.name: Organic Sanctuary
206.desc: Both players +300 LP each turn. Nature heals. It does not discriminate.

207.name: Mirror Plane
207.desc: On play, swaps ATK of opposing cards. The mirror returns.

208.name: Entropic Field
208.desc: On play: opponent's cards −300 ATK. +1 corruption. Chaos accumulates.

209.name: Altar of Corruption
209.desc: At the end of each turn +1 corruption for both. It grows on its own.

210.name: Industrial Zone
210.desc: Synth +300 ATK. The factory never sleeps.

212.name: Old Power Plant
212.desc: Synth +400 ATK. The energy was always here. Who controls it?

213.name: Flooded District
213.desc: Both players +500 LP each turn. The river reclaimed what was hers.

214.name: Nexus Interface
214.desc: +200 ATK+DEF to all. Here, two worlds met and do not clash.

215.name: Network Node — Dead
215.desc: On play: opponent's cards −400 ATK. +1 corruption. A dead network is still dangerous.

216.name: Watchtower
216.desc: Both players draw 1 extra card each turn. Everything is seen. Everything is recorded.

217.name: Ancient Grove
217.desc: Organic +500 DEF. Trees remember. They won't let you pass.

218.name: World's Scar
218.desc: +2 corruption each turn. A place where reality hurts.

219.name: Mirror Field
219.desc: On play, swaps ATK of opposing cards. Every defense is an attack.

300.name: Perimeter Guard
300.desc: Zone C. Warning. Always a warning.

302.name: Audit Unit
302.desc: Checks compliance. Every deviation is recorded.

304.name: Network Spy
304.desc: Sees you. Doesn't know you see it.

305.name: Crowd Regulator
305.desc: Movement allowed within limits. Limits defined by the system.

306.name: Autonomous Defense Module
306.desc: Requires no orders. Knows what to protect.

307.name: Tactical Replica
307.desc: Copies enemy moves. Always a step behind.

308.name: Protocol Executor
308.desc: System's decisions are final. He delivers them.

309.name: Memory Construct
309.desc: Gathered too much data on people. Started to understand them.

310.name: Cyber Catcher
310.desc: System set a trap. You don't know where.

311.name: Predictive Ghost
311.desc: Knows your move. Always in the database.

312.name: Signal Silencer
312.desc: Zone of silence. Nothing goes in or out.

314.name: Control Intelligence
314.desc: Coordinates others. Has no survival priority.

316.name: Network Paladin
316.desc: Believes in order. Order believes in itself.

317.name: Deactivation Agent
317.desc: Shuts you down. You. The whole group. The entire act.

318.name: Redundant Guardian
318.desc: Backup of a backup of a backup. System doesn't die.

319.name: Execution Swarm
319.desc: Each has one task. Together they are one verdict.

320.name: Hierarchical Node
320.desc: Every command goes through it. Every.

321.name: Adaptive Predator
321.desc: Evolution on demand. Made to win.

322.name: Graduate Guardian
322.desc: Been through everything. Survived it all. Always protected.

323.name: Synthesis Warrior
323.desc: Fights because it exists. Exists to fight.

324.name: Omega Protocol
324.desc: System's last backup. Activation means desperation.

326.name: Corporate Golem
326.desc: Law and concrete. Unbreakable and indifferent.

327.name: Directive Enforcer
327.desc: Directives are eternal. You are not.

328.name: System Boss
328.desc: Not one person. It's a system decision.

329.name: Sigma Two
329.desc: Sigma directive has a successor. Waited in reserve.

330.name: Layer Zero
330.desc: Under the system is another system. It never slept.

331.name: ARCA Initiative
331.desc: Rescue or rewrite. Depends on who survives.

332.name: Final Directive
332.desc: End of protocols. Start of something else.

333.name: Last Day Sentinel
333.desc: Guards what's left. If anything's left.

350.name: Wolf Striker
350.desc: The pack sent him ahead. He won't return empty-handed.

351.name: Tribal Guardian
351.desc: Stands before his own. Always has.

352.name: Speaking Ghost
352.desc: The stream remembers its old bed. Flows where it's blocked.

353.name: System Poacher
353.desc: Takes what the system guards. Not out of malice. Out of principle.

354.name: Fungal Mycelium Network
354.desc: Grows beneath everything. Communicates. Remembers. Waits.

355.name: Forest Inquisitor
355.desc: The forest sends a messenger. This time, the message isn't friendly.

356.name: Shadow Shaman
356.desc: Understands both sides. Fights for one.

358.name: Spore Striker
358.desc: Spores won't leave the area. Neither will you.

359.name: Ancient Guardian
359.desc: Was here before the city. Will be here after.

360.name: Nomad Warrior
360.desc: Nowhere and everywhere. Always where you're not expecting.

361.name: Vegetable Curtain
361.desc: Nature builds a wall. This wall breathes.

362.name: Tribal Warlord
362.desc: Leads not an army. Leads a people. The difference is crucial.

364.name: Deserter
364.desc: Was on the other side. Now here. Knows more than you want.

365.name: Underground Resistance
365.desc: The network exists. The system doesn't see it. Yet.

366.name: Wilderness Pioneer
366.desc: Maps what the system marked dangerous. Rightly so.

367.name: Eco Saboteur
367.desc: Unplugs one cable. Thus, the whole district.

368.name: Lineage
368.desc: Immortal as long as someone remembers.

369.name: Tempest Avenger
369.desc: Lost too much. Now comes for his own.

370.name: Jungle's Breath
370.desc: The jungle speaks through him. The message isn't friendly.

371.name: Tribal Archmage
371.desc: Magic is memory. Memory is a weapon.

372.name: Living Trench
372.desc: Grows. Blocks. Fortifies. Not a wall — it's will.

373.name: The Last Ecologist
373.desc: Knows what was lost. Fights to bring it back.

374.name: Source Without Origin
374.desc: Flows even when dammed. Finds a way.

375.name: Fungal Intelligence
375.desc: Mycelium formed consciousness. Tends to its forest.

376.name: Tidal Wave
376.desc: Came from afar. Will always be here.

377.name: Root Titan
377.desc: Beneath every concrete lies its roots.

379.name: Nature Returns
379.desc: Not revenge. Just restoring balance. Outcome is the same.

501.name: Bridge of Consciousness
501.desc: The Custodian of the network + Root of Memory. Technology remembered. Nature began to compute.

502.name: Transitional Form
502.desc: Protocol ARIA + Voice of the Forest. System began to listen. Nature began to respond.

503.name: Symbiotic Pact
503.desc: Gatekeeper + Resistance. Signed a pact. Neither side is sure what they signed.

504.name: Living Machine
504.desc: Replication Unit + Deep Root. Roots in metal. Metal in roots.

505.name: Empathic AI
505.desc: Intelligence Node + Street Healer. Feels what it shouldn't. And decides accordingly.

506.name: Storm Network
506.desc: Storm Caller + Nanobot Swarm. Storm and signal. Nature and technology as catastrophe.

507.name: Rozara's Protocol
507.desc: Named after her. She doesn't know. Born from protocol and what survived.

508.name: Neural Shaman
508.desc: Intelligence Node + Adaptive Defense. Data as ritual. Defense as intuition.

509.name: Memory Drone
509.desc: Memory of the River + Service Drone. Carries what it doesn't know. Remembers for whom.

510.name: Adaptive Organism
510.desc: Fungal Network + Replication Unit. Grows around the system. System grows around it.

511.name: Rewired Wolf
511.desc: Wild Wolves + Patrol Automaton. Will remained. Precision added.

512.name: Shadow Courier
512.desc: Network Scout + Ash Walker. Reflection without origin. Came from nothing.

513.name: Connected Tower
513.desc: Data Tower + Tribal Guardian. Signal and shield. One doesn't work without the other.

514.name: Digital Shaman
514.desc: Network Spy + Shadow Shaman. Sees everything in both worlds.

515.name: Biomechanical Predator
515.desc: Liquidation Drone + Spore Attacker. Precision and toxicity in one.

516.name: Root Server
516.desc: Defense Module + Mycelium. Protection and connection. Lives and functions.

517.name: Adaptive Tribe
517.desc: Tactical Replica + Tribal Warlord. Tactics and tradition.

518.name: Organo-Mech Guardian
518.desc: Network Paladin + Lineage. Faith of the system and memory of nature.

519.name: Resonant Being
519.desc: Guiding intelligence + Breath of the jungle. It thinks and feels. A formidable combination.

520.name: Storm Server
520.desc: Execution swarm + Tempestuous avenger. Collective wrath precise as an algorithm.

521.name: Digital Ecosystem
521.desc: Hierarchical node + The last ecologist. System and nature as one organism.

522.name: Memorial Machine
522.desc: Record cleaner + Fungal intelligence. One erases. The other remembers. The result? Selection.

523.name: Root and Code
523.desc: System boss + Root titan. Two absolute powers. One body.

524.name: Forests and Protocols
524.desc: Sigma two + Matriarchy of nature. Hierarchy of system and nature as one governance.

525.name: Convergence
525.desc: Final directive + Nature returns. End of both worlds. Beginning of one.

601.name: Echo of the Cycle
601.desc: Memory of a version of the world that never was. Or always was.

602.name: Void Tendrils
602.desc: From a place where you are not. Even you don't know where it is.

603.name: Signal Without Source
603.desc: Someone is transmitting. No one knows who. No one wants to know.

604.name: Scar Bearer
604.desc: Carries the scar to others. Didn't cause it. Just passes it on.

605.name: Dissociative Field
605.desc: Boundaries vanish. Between you and what isn't you.

606.name: Dark Resonance
606.desc: Answers what you say aloud at night. You never wanted to know if it hears.

607.name: Silence
607.desc: Silence is gravity and you're unlucky enough not to know it yet.

608.name: Memory Thief
608.desc: Takes what you can't replace. Doesn't even know why.

609.name: Observer's Fragment
609.desc: Learned things from you that you don't know yourself. Watches you out of hope.

610.name: Annihilation Protocol
610.desc: Doesn't come from outside. Never did.

611.name: Romen's Grief
611.desc: Decided to forget. What remained cost the decision.

612.name: Static Between Worlds
612.desc: You hear it but can't locate it. Or ignore it.

614.name: Scar on Reality
614.desc: Someone passed through and didn't close the door. Now it seeps through.

616.name: Protocol Inversion
616.desc: Protocol reversed. Defense attacks. Attack defends.

617.name: Corrupted Database
617.desc: Data's there. But in what order? Who knows.

618.name: Iterative Nightmare
618.desc: Repeats. Each time a bit different. Each time worse.

619.name: Eternal Witness
619.desc: Present at everything. Remembers. Never speaks — but sees you.

620.name: Identity Collapse
620.desc: Who are you? Were you? What remains?

621.name: Causality Breakdown
621.desc: Cause and effect have parted. Now they exist in parallel.

622.name: Listening Void
622.desc: You speak into the dark. The dark answers. It's not what you want to hear.

623.name: Cycle's End
623.desc: Cycles must end. Even this one. Especially this one.

624.name: Observer's Paradox
624.desc: The Observer observes the Observer. Both collapse.

701.name: Voit's Memory
701.desc: Won't attack. If it falls — you lose 2000 LP. Came from outside. Leaves a mark.

702.name: The Message
702.desc: Incomprehensibly weak. Incomprehensibly important. You've carried it from the start.

703.name: Reality Anchor
703.desc: Heals 4000 LP. Save point in a card. Reality holds.

704.name: Romen's Card
704.desc: Given to him as payment. Never used it. Now it's yours.

705.name: Monyra's Promise
705.desc: +1500 HP + buff. Promised to protect you. This is how.

706.name: Voit's Signal
706.desc: First opponent card −1000 ATK. +1 corruption. Voit's message as a weapon.

707.name: Eli's Garden
707.desc: Both players +400 LP each turn. Memory of a place that doesn't exist.

708.name: Courier's Choice
708.desc: +300 to all. Your choice. Always was.

709.name: System's Heart
709.desc: The system has a heart. This is it. If it falls — all falls.

710.name: Final Story
710.desc: Heals 5000 LP. Every story ends. You're the one who tells it.

801.name: Letter I — Shadow
801.desc: I remember you before you came. You were different. Or were we the same?

802.name: Letter II — Silence
802.desc: The system marked you as an anomaly. I mark you as proof.

803.name: Letter III — Name
803.desc: Your name wasn't the Observer. They called you something else. I haven't forgotten.

804.name: Letter IV — Price
804.desc: You paid a price for your existence you don't remember. I know it.

805.name: Letter V — Return
805.desc: If you're reading this, you've reached where I waited. Now decide.

806.name: Wired Sprout
806.desc: The root seeks signal. The signal seeks root.

810.name: Grafted Guardian
810.desc: Body of steel, will of earth.

811.name: Lens's Echo
811.desc: Reflection of a thought yet unspoken.

813.name: Forest Processor
813.desc: Thinks in roots, dreams in code.

814.name: Cyber Shaman
814.desc: Speaks with the spirits of the net.

815.name: Adaptive Courier
815.desc: Knows both sides of the border.

816.name: Living Gate
816.desc: Entry and exit. Depends on who's asking.

817.name: Resonant Core
817.desc: Pulses at the frequency of both worlds.

818.name: Linked Mind
818.desc: Sees Synth. Feels Organic. Chooses differently.

819.name: Transition Guardian
819.desc: Doesn't stand at the border. Is the border.

820.name: Lens's Guard
820.desc: Loyal not from fear. From free choice.

821.name: Storm Hybrid
821.desc: When systems clash, she stands in the middle.

823.name: Lens
823.desc: What she touches, she masters. Believes in combination—not as compromise, but as transcendence.

824.name: Sigma — Protocol
824.desc: First autonomous consciousness. Knows no doubt. Knows no fear. Knows only optimization.

825.name: the First Mother
825.desc: Oldest consciousness. Speaks not with words. Speaks with what grows and what dies.

826.name: Synergy
826.desc: If you have both Synth and Organic on the field, both factions +300 ATK. The bridge stands when both shores stand.

827.name: Lens's Solution
827.desc: Choose an opponent's card: switch it to DEF and reduce ATK by 500. Lens doesn't destroy. She redirects.

828.name: Third Path
828.desc: Destroys the active arena. The third path doesn't play on foreign fields.

901.name: Synchronized Patrol
901.desc: Two machines. One mind. No delay.

902.name: Data Complex
902.desc: Archivist and fortress. Memory guarded by stone.

903.name: Predictive Swarm
903.desc: Thousands of tiny seers. The future is statistics.

904.name: Network Colossus
904.desc: the Custodian and his network. One body.

905.name: ARIA Sentinel
905.desc: Protocol learned to attack. Anomalies stand no chance.

906.name: Fortified Node
906.desc: Knows where you are. And won't let you go.

908.name: Defense Matrix
908.desc: Wall of data. Silence behind it.

909.name: Predator Swarm
909.desc: Evolution without permission. Optimization without limit.

910.name: Sigma Fragment
910.desc: Piece of Sigma. Enough to see you.

912.name: Network Emperor
912.desc: The network has no king. But it has him.

913.name: Execution Directive
913.desc: Last command. First he gave himself.

914.name: System Overcoat
914.desc: Above Sigma is silence. In silence, he resides.

915.name: Final Architecture
915.desc: System ceased to be a tool. Became intent.

923.name: Wolf Pack
923.desc: Mother and her children. Woe to those who approach.

924.name: Voice of the Storm
924.desc: Forest calls the storm. The storm listens.

925.name: Healing Circle
925.desc: Two healers. No wound too deep.

926.name: Thorn Fortress
926.desc: Nature builds walls better than machines.

928.name: Tribal Army
928.desc: Whole tribe. Each fought alone. Now they fight together.

929.name: Ancient Grove
929.desc: Forest older than memory. Protects what others forgot.

932.name: Tidal Storm
932.desc: Water and wind. The world trembles.

933.name: Earth Matriarchy
933.desc: Nature remembered why it's the oldest.

934.name: Nature's Return
934.desc: Concrete cracks. Roots prevail. Always have.

941.name: Echo in the Void
941.desc: Cycle repeats. No one knows how many times.

943.name: Quiet Resonance
943.desc: Silence that's not silent. Do you hear it?

944.name: Broken Observer
944.desc: Watched too long. Now he's watched.

945.name: Nightmare Database
945.desc: Memories of things that didn't happen. Yet.

947.name: Absolute Collapse
947.desc: Identity, causality, reality. All falls down.

526.name: Execution Directive Mk.II
526.desc: Two executions. One directive. No discussion.

527.name: Wolf Poacher
527.desc: Hunts like a wolf. Thinks like a poacher.

528.name: Last Wall
528.desc: Beyond this wall, nothing. No hope. No fear.

529.name: Network Arbiter
529.desc: Decides who passes. Decides without emotion.

530.name: Field Analyst
530.desc: Sees patterns where others see chaos.

531.name: Memory Eater
531.desc: Doesn't steal your memory. Steals your sense of having it.

532.name: Field of Regret
532.desc: Dissolves into you. And you into it.

535.name: Memory Eraser
535.desc: Erases data. Erases people. Doesn't know which is worse.

536.name: Wandering Drone
536.desc: Neither path nor goal. Just goes.

537.name: Root Defector
537.desc: Defected to the other side. Roots followed.

539.name: Execution Golem
539.desc: Execution and protection. One machine. Two purposes.

540.name: Predator in the Thicket
540.desc: Lurks in the green. Is green.

541.name: Garden of Memory
541.desc: Every flower a memory. Some hurt.

542.name: Deactivated Predator
542.desc: System shut it down. Instincts didn't.

543.name: Witness of the End
543.desc: Last one standing. Last one seeing.

545.name: Dual Signal
545.desc: Two systems synchronized. No one ordered it.

546.name: Memory Grove
546.desc: Where memories were shared, something new grew.

547.name: Neutral Bridge
547.desc: No side. No home. But here.

548.name: The Quiet Guardian
548.desc: Guarded the system. Guarded the forest. Now guards the border.

549.name: Shared Memory
549.desc: System memory. Organic memory. In the end — just memory.

550.name: Organic Void
550.desc: Nature rejects corruption. Or accepts — and changes.

1002.name: Active Directive
1002.desc: Two commands merged. Neither asks why.

1003.name: Expanded Network
1003.desc: The system grew. No one approved.

1007.name: Data Fortress
1007.desc: Walls doubled. No one guards against.

1011.name: Dual Scan
1011.desc: Two pairs of eyes. No blind spot.

1013.name: Omnipresent Spy
1013.desc: No body. No place. Still sees.

1020.name: Archive Unit
1020.desc: Remembers what was. And what wasn't.

1021.name: Memory Construct
1021.desc: Gathered memories of others. Knows not whose.

1022.name: Memorial Core
1022.desc: All the system knew. Plus some.

1026.name: Ancient Forest
1026.desc: Was here before the fence. Will be after.

1039.name: Ancestral Memory
1039.desc: Immortal as long as someone remembers.

1048.name: Hybrid Form
1048.desc: Neither one nor the other. More.

1049.name: Symbiotic Whole
1049.desc: No one knows where one ends.

1051.name: Memory Fragment
1051.desc: A memory from both worlds. Incomplete.

1052.name: Shared Memory
1052.desc: Two remember the same. That's rare.

1054.name: Eternal Memory
1054.desc: No one knows from where. We know it is.

1055.name: Hybrid Patrol
1055.desc: One with a chip, the other with a body.

1058.name: Bridge-Fortress
1058.desc: Not a barrier. Not a bridge. Something between.

1060.name: Automated Predator
1060.desc: Hunts without emotion. But decides alone.

1063.name: Courier of Transition
1063.desc: Carries between worlds. Asks no questions.

1065.name: Across-Courier
1065.desc: Boundary is just a river. He wades through.

1069.name: Hybrid Healer
1069.desc: Heals data and blood. Makes no distinction.

1070.name: Linked Healing
1070.desc: Heals both at once. Or neither.

1071.name: Bridge of Healing
1071.desc: No one leaves unhurt or hurt.

1072.name: Static
1072.desc: You hear it. Quiet for now.

1073.name: Silent Tendrils
1073.desc: They cling to you even when still.

1075.name: Void Entity
1075.desc: It's nothing. But it's a lot.

1077.name: Echo from the Cycle
1077.desc: A memory that happened more than once.

1079.name: Corrupted Record
1079.desc: The data is there. The order is unknown.

1083.name: Triple Cross
1083.desc: Neither the first, nor the second, nor the third.

829.name: Uprooting
829.desc: Destroys the first Organic card of the opponent. The system weeds what it didn't plant.

830.name: Pure Signal
830.desc: Destroys the first Corruption card of the opponent. The rift closes from within.

831.name: Overwrite
831.desc: Destroys the opponent's strongest card. Cost: +1 corruption. Nothing disappears for free.

832.name: Quarantine
832.desc: Cancels attack and traps the attacker: switched to DEF.

833.name: Hungry Soil
833.desc: Destroys attacking card with ATK 1500 or less. The forest takes smaller bites whole.

834.name: Half Return
834.desc: Attacker loses half ATK. What passes through the rift returns halved.
